JavaScript with exports, verify export count

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"javascript\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "export function greet(name) {\n  return `Hello ${name}`;\n}\n\nexport const VERSION = '1.0';\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language)
debugPrint(result.exports)
```
